_doc: Wave-2 Specialization trees (Fable, 2026-11-10; design in docs/SPECS.md "Wave 2"; the roster in data/specs.json). Six pure specs - Knight (Fighter), Assassin and Swashbuckler (Rogue), Frostbinder and Stormcaller (Mage), Oracle (Healer) - three trees each, 9-10 nodes a tree, levels 10/11/12/14/16/18/20, ranks to 10 (short utilities 3-5). SAME SCHEMA as skills-specs-1.json (owner = the spec id, tree = the tree id in specs.json). No hybrids in this wave, so no altCost. NEW IDEAS THAT RUN ON THE ENGINE AS IT IS: the Swashbuckler's flair is a +damage buff written by EVERY one of its skills under that skill's own fx id (ctx.sk.id + ":damage"), so different skills stack through fxPct and the same skill twice only refreshes - a variety counter with no new code (the `flair` key on Grandeur is the wishlist's better form); the Knight's "take a friend's hits" is a ward on the friend plus a taunt circle at THEIR feet (`area at: target` with a taunt reaches foes round an ally target, as Daybreak Descent proved in wave 1); the Assassin's Decoy and the Stormcaller's Storm Orbs are short-lived minions (a tank with a 3 s taunt, three storm casters) through the summon effect. ENGINE FACTS THIS LEANS ON: one dot per skill per target (fx id = skill id + ":dot", so a second dot in the same skill would overwrite the first - every skill here carries at most one); a `buff` with `stat: armour` on a hero and `damageDown`/`weaken` on a foe both work since the wave-1 fixes; `buff` stats the engine reads are damage, crit, castSpeed, armour, healTaken, threat (dodge and moveSpeed buffs are NOT read - every "parry" here is a ward). NUMBERS as wave 1: a spec filler is 1.1-1.3x a swing or ~1.4x a Path bolt, big hits 2.5-4x on 8-25 s cooldowns, capstones at 20 on 20-90 s; costs sit where a Path runs flat out ~30 s then lean (temper 15-50, energy 20-50, mana 14-60).

kni_sworn_guard.name: Sworn Guard
kni_sworn_guard.desc: Swear yourself to a friend within 20 m: a {dmg} ward and +20% armour on them for 8 seconds, and everything within 5 m of them turns on you instead. Your opener on whoever the pack will pick.

kni_steel_vow.name: Steel Vow
kni_steel_vow.desc: A vow is a heavier thing than plate. More health.

kni_intercept.name: Intercept
kni_intercept.desc: Throw yourself 20 m between a friend and what is coming: a {dmg} ward on them, and everything within 4 m of them turns on you. Does not use the global cooldown.

kni_vigil_plate.name: Vigil Plate
kni_vigil_plate.desc: Your plate was made for standing still in. Your armour counts for more.

kni_shared_shield.name: Shared Shield
kni_shared_shield.desc: Raise the shield over everyone: a {dmg} ward on every friend within 10 m for 8 seconds.

kni_steadfast_vow.name: Steadfast Vow
kni_steadfast_vow.desc: Sworn Guard wards for more per rank.

kni_bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
kni_bodyguard.desc: Stand over a friend within 20 m: heal them for {dmg}, ward them, heals land 15% harder on them for 8 seconds, and everything within 6 m of them turns on you.

kni_oath_of_iron.name: Oath of Iron
kni_oath_of_iron.desc: Every blow you land mends you a little. Life on hit.

kni_unbreakable_vow.name: Unbreakable Vow
kni_unbreakable_vow.desc: The vow made whole: a friend within 20 m is healed for {dmg}, wrapped in a great ward for 10 seconds with heals landing 20% harder, everything within 8 m of them turns on you, and you have 30 temper to hold them with. The Sworn Guard capstone.

kni_challenge.name: Challenge
kni_challenge.desc: Bang the shield: everything within 10 m comes for you and hits 12% softer for {secs} seconds, and you take 10 temper from the noise. Does not use the global cooldown.

kni_loud_steel.name: Loud Steel
kni_loud_steel.desc: They cannot ignore you. Everything you do draws more threat.

kni_shield_blow.name: Shield Blow
kni_shield_blow.desc: Drive the rim into your target for {mult} weapon damage, and it comes for you. Three times the threat of a normal blow; needs no shield. The tank's filler.

kni_rim_strike.name: Rim Strike
kni_rim_strike.desc: Crack the rim across its jaw for {mult} weapon damage and a {secs} second stun, and it comes for you when it wakes.

kni_bellow.name: Bellow
kni_bellow.desc: A shout that breaks a cast from 12 m: it stops, the caster is silenced for a moment and cannot start another for {secs} seconds, and it comes for you. Does not use the global cooldown.

kni_heavy_hand.name: Heavy Hand
kni_heavy_hand.desc: Shield Blow lands harder: more damage per rank.

kni_unbowed.name: Unbowed
kni_unbowed.desc: Fire, frost, storm, poison and shadow all find you harder to hurt. Resist all.

kni_sweeping_challenge.name: Sweeping Challenge
kni_sweeping_challenge.desc: A wide swing of the rim: {mult} weapon damage to everything in a 120 degree arc 5 m deep, each one comes for you, and their armour is cracked by 10% for 6 seconds.

kni_iron_summons.name: Iron Summons
kni_iron_summons.desc: Everything within 10 m is dragged 3 m toward you, struck for {mult} weapon damage, stunned for 1.5 seconds and wants only you when it wakes. The Challenge capstone.

kni_raise_banner.name: Raise the Banner
kni_raise_banner.desc: Plant the banner on a spot up to 15 m away: every friend standing within 8 m of it gets +20% armour and mends {dmg} a second for {secs} seconds.

kni_banner_bearer.name: Banner Bearer
kni_banner_bearer.desc: Carrying the standard into a fight feeds the temper. More temper from every hit landed or taken.

kni_stand_together.name: Stand Together
kni_stand_together.desc: Every friend within 10 m gets a {dmg} ward for 8 seconds, and heals land 20% harder on the whole party for 10 seconds.

kni_heavy_standard.name: Heavy Standard
kni_heavy_standard.desc: The arm that carries the banner swings the sword. More melee power.

kni_hold_fast.name: Hold Fast
kni_hold_fast.desc: Brace: +50% armour and a {dmg} ward for 10 seconds, and 20 temper to spend. Does not use the global cooldown.

kni_wide_banner.name: Wide Banner
kni_wide_banner.desc: The banner reaches further: a wider circle per rank.

kni_guardian_banner.name: Guardian Banner
kni_guardian_banner.desc: Plant a second standard up to 15 m away: every friend within 8 m of it is healed for {dmg}, shakes off slows, roots, stuns and poisons, and gets +15% armour for 10 seconds.

kni_steel_cadence.name: Steel Cadence
kni_steel_cadence.desc: A drumbeat in the swing. More attack speed.

kni_long_standing.name: Long Standing
kni_long_standing.desc: Stand Together lasts longer: more seconds per rank.

kni_unbroken_banner.name: Unbroken Banner
kni_unbroken_banner.desc: Raise the banner over everyone: every friend within 12 m is healed for {dmg}, wrapped in a ward, cleansed, and gets +40% armour with heals landing 20% harder for 10 seconds; you take 30 temper. The Banner capstone.

asn_venom_strike.name: Venom Strike
asn_venom_strike.desc: A cut with a coated blade for {mult} weapon damage, and poison for {secs} seconds after. Your filler; keep the poison up on everything that will live long enough.

asn_quick_poisons.name: Quick Poisons
asn_quick_poisons.desc: Fast hands at the vial. Energy comes back faster.

asn_blackroot_dart.name: Blackroot Dart
asn_blackroot_dart.desc: A dart from 20 m for {dmg} poison damage and a slow poison for {secs} seconds. For the thing you cannot reach yet.

asn_lingering.name: Lingering
asn_lingering.desc: Venom Strike's poison lasts longer: more seconds per rank.

asn_fester.name: Fester
asn_fester.desc: Press on the wound: {dmg} poison damage at once. Throw it when the target is carrying poison and bleed.

asn_steady_hand.name: Steady Hand
asn_steady_hand.desc: A knife-hand that does not shake. More attack speed.

asn_blood_and_bile.name: Blood and Bile
asn_blood_and_bile.desc: A deep cut for {mult} weapon damage that bleeds for {secs} seconds on top of whatever poison it carries.

asn_spreading_rot.name: Spreading Rot
asn_spreading_rot.desc: The poison jumps: {dmg} poison damage to everything within 5 m of your target and a rot for {secs} seconds on all of it.

asn_virulence.name: Virulence
asn_virulence.desc: Venom Strike bites deeper and its poison burns hotter: more damage per rank.

asn_plague_knife.name: Plague Knife
asn_plague_knife.desc: One knife, every vial: {mult} weapon damage to the target, {dmg} poison damage to everything within 6 m of it, and a plague on all of them for {secs} seconds. The Venoms capstone.

asn_grave_mark.name: Grave Mark
asn_grave_mark.desc: A cut for {mult} weapon damage that marks the target: it takes +20% damage from everyone for {secs} seconds. Longer and deeper than a Notch. It pays twice: once for you, once for the party.

asn_cold_eye.name: Cold Eye
asn_cold_eye.desc: You see where the blade should go. More critical chance.

asn_gutting_strike.name: Gutting Strike
asn_gutting_strike.desc: The cash-in: {mult} weapon damage in one cut. Best from behind.

asn_sap.name: Sap
asn_sap.desc: A pommel to the back of the head: {mult} weapon damage and the target is out for {secs} seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

asn_opening.name: The Opening
asn_opening.desc: Gutting Strike cuts deeper: more damage per rank.

asn_throat_cut.name: Throat Cut
asn_throat_cut.desc: A cut across the throat for {mult} weapon damage: the cast stops, the caster is silenced for a moment and cannot start another for {secs} seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

asn_exposed.name: Exposed
asn_exposed.desc: Cut the straps: {mult} weapon damage and the target's armour is down 20% for {secs} seconds.

asn_deadly_patience.name: Deadly Patience
asn_deadly_patience.desc: Wait, then cut. More melee power.

asn_second_mark.name: Second Mark
asn_second_mark.desc: Grave Mark lasts longer: more seconds per rank.

asn_execution.name: Execution
asn_execution.desc: It ends here: {mult} weapon damage in one stroke. Save it for the one you set up. The Set-up capstone.

asn_vanish_step.name: Vanish Step
asn_vanish_step.desc: Gone: 8 m back in a blink, a {dmg} ward for 4 seconds, and your next cuts are +15% likely to crit for 5 seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

asn_decoy.name: Decoy
asn_decoy.desc: Leave a straw-and-cloak decoy that shouts at the pack: it draws everything within 6 m onto itself for {secs} seconds or until it is cut down. Ranks make it tougher.

asn_smoke_pouch.name: Smoke Pouch
asn_smoke_pouch.desc: Throw a pouch up to 15 m: a 4 m cloud where everything moves at half speed and hits 20% softer for {secs} seconds.

asn_hush.name: Hush
asn_hush.desc: A needle from 20 m: {dmg} poison damage and the target cannot cast for {secs} seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

asn_thicker_smoke.name: Thicker Smoke
asn_thicker_smoke.desc: Smoke Pouch covers more ground: a wider cloud per rank.

asn_knife_storm.name: Knife Storm
asn_knife_storm.desc: Every knife you carry, all at once: {mult} weapon damage to everything within 6 m and each one slowed by 30% for 3 seconds. The pack answer.

asn_shadow_sense.name: Shadow Sense
asn_shadow_sense.desc: You feel the swing before it lands. More dodge.

asn_storm_edge.name: Storm Edge
asn_storm_edge.desc: Knife Storm throws sharper: more damage per rank.

asn_thousand_cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
asn_thousand_cuts.desc: Three seconds of knives: {mult} weapon damage every second to everything within 6 m, and all of it bleeds for {secs} seconds after. Moving stops it. The Slip Away capstone.

fro_frost_shard.name: Frost Shard
fro_frost_shard.desc: A shard of ice for {dmg} frost damage from 25 m that slows the target by 30% for 4 seconds. Your filler: everything you hit is slower afterwards.

fro_cold_study.name: Cold Study
fro_cold_study.desc: Years with the frost. More spell power.

fro_rime_burst.name: Rime Burst
fro_rime_burst.desc: Rime bursts off the target for {dmg} frost damage, instant, and it moves at 60% speed for 3 seconds. Cast on the move.

fro_rime_spear.name: Rime Spear
fro_rime_spear.desc: A spear of ice for {dmg} frost damage. The shatter: throw it at something already slowed.

fro_sharper_shards.name: Sharper Shards
fro_sharper_shards.desc: Frost Shard cuts deeper: more damage per rank.

fro_shatter.name: Shatter
fro_shatter.desc: Everything within 5 m of your target shatters for {dmg} frost damage and staggers for a second.

fro_brittle.name: Brittle
fro_brittle.desc: Cold things break along their cracks. More critical chance.

fro_keen_spear.name: Keen Spear
fro_keen_spear.desc: Rime Spear hits harder: more damage per rank.

fro_stillfrost.name: Stillfrost
fro_stillfrost.desc: Freeze the target solid for {secs} seconds and break it: {dmg} frost damage. The Rime capstone.

fro_whiteout.name: Whiteout
fro_whiteout.desc: Call a blizzard onto a 5 m circle up to 25 m away for three seconds: {dmg} frost damage a second and everything in it moves at 60% speed. Moving stops it.

fro_banked_cold.name: Banked Cold
fro_banked_cold.desc: The cold keeps. Mana comes back faster.

fro_ice_wall.name: Ice Wall
fro_ice_wall.desc: Raise a wall of ice along an 8 m line in front of you: everything in it takes {dmg} frost damage and is frozen to the spot for {secs} seconds.

fro_blizzard.name: Blizzard
fro_blizzard.desc: A storm on a 7 m circle up to 25 m away: {dmg} frost damage, the cold bites for {secs} seconds after, and everything in it moves at half speed.

fro_wider_white.name: Wider White
fro_wider_white.desc: Whiteout covers more ground: a wider circle per rank.

fro_glacier.name: Glacier
fro_glacier.desc: Ice heaves up through a 4 m circle up to 25 m away: {dmg} frost damage and everything in it is held for {secs} seconds. Ground that holds.

fro_lasting_cold.name: Lasting Cold
fro_lasting_cold.desc: Blizzard's cold lingers: more seconds per rank.

fro_snowblind.name: Snowblind
fro_snowblind.desc: Driven snow on a 6 m circle up to 25 m away: everything in it hits 20% softer and moves at 70% speed for {secs} seconds. The control tool.

fro_endless_winter.name: Endless Winter
fro_endless_winter.desc: Four seconds of winter on an 8 m circle up to 25 m away: {dmg} frost damage a second and everything in it crawls at 40% speed. Moving stops it. The Whiteout capstone.

fro_ice_ward.name: Ice Ward
fro_ice_ward.desc: Ice over your skin: a ward that soaks {dmg} for 8 seconds, and the cold off it slows everything within 4 m by 40% for 3 seconds.

fro_winter_skin.name: Winter Skin
fro_winter_skin.desc: What the frost cannot touch, nothing else touches easily. Resist all.

fro_spellrush.name: Spellrush
fro_spellrush.desc: Stillness between the heartbeats: your casts are 60% faster for {secs} seconds and you take 20 mana. Three fast casts, free. Does not use the global cooldown.

fro_freeze.name: Freeze
fro_freeze.desc: Freeze one target solid from 25 m for {secs} seconds, for {dmg} frost damage. The hold.

fro_frost_step.name: Frost Step
fro_frost_step.desc: Step 8 m back and leave everything within 3 m of where you stood frozen to the spot for {secs} seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

fro_stifling_cold.name: Stifling Cold
fro_stifling_cold.desc: Cold in the throat from 25 m: the cast stops, the caster cannot start another for {secs} seconds, and it moves at half speed for 3 seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

fro_thicker_ice.name: Thicker Ice
fro_thicker_ice.desc: Ice Ward soaks more: a bigger ward per rank.

fro_absolute_zero.name: Absolute Zero
fro_absolute_zero.desc: Everything stops but you: a {dmg} ward for 8 seconds, everything within 8 m frozen for 2.5 seconds and bitten for frost damage, and 50 mana. Does not use the global cooldown. The Stillness capstone.

sto_forked_bolt.name: Forked Bolt
sto_forked_bolt.desc: A bolt for {dmg} storm damage from 25 m that forks on landing into everything within 4 m of the target. Your filler: it is a pack spell that costs what a bolt costs.

sto_charged_mind.name: Charged Mind
sto_charged_mind.desc: Static in the thoughts. More spell power.

sto_shock_mark.name: Shock Mark
sto_shock_mark.desc: Shock the target for {dmg} storm damage: shocked things take +15% damage from everything for {secs} seconds.

sto_static.name: Static
sto_static.desc: A charge waiting to jump. More critical chance.

sto_arc_lash.name: Arc Lash
sto_arc_lash.desc: A whip of lightning for {dmg} storm damage, instant, cast on the move, and the target's arms are numb: it hits 10% softer for 4 seconds.

sto_wider_fork.name: Wider Fork
sto_wider_fork.desc: Forked Bolt reaches further: a wider fork per rank.

sto_storm_beam.name: Storm Beam
sto_storm_beam.desc: Hold a beam on the target for three seconds: {dmg} storm damage a second and it moves at 70% speed. Moving stops it.

sto_conductor.name: Conductor
sto_conductor.desc: Forked Bolt hits harder: more damage per rank.

sto_chain_tempest.name: Chain Tempest
sto_chain_tempest.desc: A bolt for {dmg} storm damage that jumps the whole pack: everything within 6 m of the target is struck and staggers for a second. The Forked capstone.

sto_thunder_ring.name: Thunder Ring
sto_thunder_ring.desc: A clap of thunder off you: {dmg} storm damage to everything within 5 m and each one staggers for half a second. The thing to press when they reach you.

sto_storm_orbs.name: Storm Orbs
sto_storm_orbs.desc: Three orbs of lightning circle you for {secs} seconds, each throwing bolts at whatever you fight. Ranks make them hit harder.

sto_thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
sto_thunderclap.desc: Thunder on a 5 m circle up to 25 m away: {dmg} storm damage and everything in it is stunned for {secs} seconds. Lands where you point.

sto_wider_ring.name: Wider Ring
sto_wider_ring.desc: Thunder Ring reaches further: a wider circle per rank.

sto_rolling_thunder.name: Rolling Thunder
sto_rolling_thunder.desc: Three seconds of thunder on a 6 m circle up to 25 m away: {dmg} storm damage a second and everything in it moves at 70% speed. Moving stops it.

sto_louder_clap.name: Louder Clap
sto_louder_clap.desc: Thunderclap hits harder: more damage per rank.

sto_eye_of_tempest.name: Eye of the Tempest
sto_eye_of_tempest.desc: Four seconds of storm on an 8 m circle up to 25 m away: {dmg} storm damage a second, everything in it crawls at 60% speed and takes +10% damage from everything. Moving stops it. The Thunder capstone.

sto_bolt_step.name: Bolt Step
sto_bolt_step.desc: Become the lightning: everything along the 10 m line in front of you takes {dmg} storm damage and staggers, and you are at the far end of it. Does not use the global cooldown.

sto_wind_ward.name: Wind Ward
sto_wind_ward.desc: A wall of moving air: a ward that soaks {dmg} for 8 seconds, and your casts are 15% faster while it holds.

sto_crackle.name: Crackle
sto_crackle.desc: A snap of lightning from 25 m: the cast stops, the caster is silenced for a moment and cannot start another for {secs} seconds, and it takes {dmg} storm damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

sto_thunder_fist.name: Thunder Fist
sto_thunder_fist.desc: Close and strike: {dmg} storm damage from 8 m and the target is stunned for {secs} seconds. The stunning strike.

sto_gale.name: Gale
sto_gale.desc: A gale over a 5 m circle up to 25 m away: {dmg} storm damage, everything in it moves at half speed and hits 15% softer for {secs} seconds.

sto_sure_footing.name: Sure Footing
sto_sure_footing.desc: Wind Ward soaks more: a bigger ward per rank.

sto_hotter_step.name: Hotter Step
sto_hotter_step.desc: Bolt Step burns harder: more damage per rank.

sto_lightning_form.name: Lightning Form
sto_lightning_form.desc: Be the storm for 10 seconds: +25% damage, casts 40% faster, a {dmg} ward, 50 mana, and everything within 6 m is struck and stunned as it begins. Does not use the global cooldown. The Bolt Step capstone.

ora_foresight.name: Foresight
ora_foresight.desc: You saw it coming: a {dmg} ward on a friend within 25 m for 10 seconds, instant. Your filler: put it on whoever the next hit is for, before the hit.

ora_shared_vision.name: Shared Vision
ora_shared_vision.desc: Everyone sees it coming: a {dmg} ward on every friend within 10 m for 8 seconds.

ora_second_sight.name: Second Sight
ora_second_sight.desc: Foresight wards for more per rank.

ora_warding_glyph.name: Warding Glyph
ora_warding_glyph.desc: Draw a glyph on a spot up to 25 m away: every friend within 5 m of it gets a {dmg} ward and mends for {secs} seconds. Lands where you point.

ora_thread_of_fate.name: Thread of Fate
ora_thread_of_fate.desc: Tie your fate to a friend within 25 m: a {dmg} ward on them for 10 seconds, a heal at once, and heals land 15% harder on them while the thread holds.

ora_lasting_sight.name: Lasting Sight
ora_lasting_sight.desc: Shared Vision wards for more per rank.

ora_seen_and_spared.name: Seen and Spared
ora_seen_and_spared.desc: The blow you foresaw never lands: every friend within 12 m gets a great ward for 10 seconds, +30% armour, and is cleansed. The Foresight capstone.

ora_kind_omen.name: Kind Omen
ora_kind_omen.desc: A good sign: heal a friend for {dmg}, mend them for {secs} seconds after, and what is left over stays as a small ward.

ora_good_omen.name: Good Omen
ora_good_omen.desc: A heal that arrives early: instant, and a friend within 25 m mends {dmg} a second for {secs} seconds. Cast it before the hit, not after.

ora_clear_the_fog.name: Clear the Fog
ora_clear_the_fog.desc: A friend within 25 m shakes off a slow, a root, a stun or a poison and is healed for {dmg}. Does not use the global cooldown.

ora_long_omen.name: Long Omen
ora_long_omen.desc: Good Omen mends for longer: more seconds per rank.

ora_circle_of_omens.name: Circle of Omens
ora_circle_of_omens.desc: Every friend within 10 m is healed for {dmg} and mends for {secs} seconds after. Instant.

ora_read_the_bones.name: Read the Bones
ora_read_the_bones.desc: Read a fallen friend's fate again: they stand at 40% health inside a {dmg} ward. Three seconds; not in the middle of a fight.

ora_fate_rewritten.name: Fate Rewritten
ora_fate_rewritten.desc: Tear the page out: a friend within 25 m is healed for {dmg}, warded, mends for {secs} seconds, is cleansed, and heals land 20% harder on them for 10 seconds. The Omens capstone.

ora_fate_bolt.name: Fate Bolt
ora_fate_bolt.desc: A bolt of what was always going to happen: {dmg} shadow damage from 25 m, and it gives 6 mana back. Attacking pays for the wards.

ora_prophecy.name: Prophecy
ora_prophecy.desc: Name the spot up to 25 m away where the blast will fall: {dmg} shadow damage on a 5 m circle and everything in it is marked to take +12% damage for {secs} seconds. Lands where you point.

ora_portent.name: Portent
ora_portent.desc: A word of warning from 25 m: the cast stops, the caster is silenced for a moment and cannot start another for {secs} seconds, and it takes {dmg} shadow damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

ora_sure_doom.name: Sure Doom
ora_sure_doom.desc: Fate Bolt hits harder: more damage per rank.

ora_what_is_coming.name: What Is Coming
ora_what_is_coming.desc: Slow what is coming: everything on a 6 m circle up to 25 m away moves at 60% speed and hits 15% softer for {secs} seconds.

ora_doom_spoken.name: Doom Spoken
ora_doom_spoken.desc: Tell the target how it ends: {dmg} shadow damage and it hits 15% softer for 6 seconds.

ora_omen_of_ruin.name: Omen of Ruin
ora_omen_of_ruin.desc: Ruin on everything within 5 m of your target: {dmg} shadow damage and a withering for {secs} seconds.

ora_last_page.name: The Last Page
ora_last_page.desc: Read the target its last page: {dmg} shadow damage and 1.5 seconds stunned by it, and the light that is left heals everyone within 6 m of you. The Prophecy capstone.

swb_flourish.name: Flourish
swb_flourish.desc: A cut with a turn of the wrist for {mult} weapon damage. Flair: every different skill you use adds its own +4% damage for 8 seconds, and they stack; the same skill twice only refreshes its own. Your filler.

swb_pinning_thrust.name: Pinning Thrust
swb_pinning_thrust.desc: Run the target through for {mult} weapon damage and pin it to the spot for {secs} seconds. Flair.

swb_deeper_thrust.name: Deeper Thrust
swb_deeper_thrust.desc: Pinning Thrust goes deeper: more damage per rank.

swb_double_thrust.name: Double Thrust
swb_double_thrust.desc: Thrust, thrust: two hits of {mult} weapon damage each. Flair.

swb_sweep.name: Sweep
swb_sweep.desc: A wide sweep across a 120 degree arc 5 m deep for {mult} weapon damage to each. The pack answer. Flair.

swb_showmanship.name: Showmanship
swb_showmanship.desc: The crowd feeds you. Energy comes back faster.

swb_wider_sweep.name: Wider Sweep
swb_wider_sweep.desc: Sweep reaches further: a deeper arc per rank.

swb_grand_sweep.name: Grand Sweep
swb_grand_sweep.desc: The whole circle in one turn: {mult} weapon damage to everything within 6 m and a 1 s stagger, and +10% damage for 10 seconds after. The Flourish capstone.

swb_daring_leap.name: Daring Leap
swb_daring_leap.desc: Leap 12 m onto your target for {mult} weapon damage. Flair. Does not use the global cooldown.

swb_mocking_parry.name: Mocking Parry
swb_mocking_parry.desc: Turn the blow aside with a bow: {mult} weapon damage as the riposte, everything within 6 m comes for you, and you catch the next hits on a {dmg} ward for 5 seconds. Flair.

swb_matadors_turn.name: Matador's Turn
swb_matadors_turn.desc: Let it charge, step aside: {mult} weapon damage as it passes, it limps at half speed for {secs} seconds, and you are 3 m clear. Flair.

swb_sure_parry.name: Sure Parry
swb_sure_parry.desc: Mocking Parry catches more: a bigger ward per rank.

swb_cutting_remark.name: Cutting Remark
swb_cutting_remark.desc: A thrown knife and a word from 15 m: {mult} weapon damage, the cast stops, and the caster cannot start another for {secs} seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

swb_the_exit.name: The Exit
swb_the_exit.desc: Bow, and leave: 10 m back, a {dmg} ward for 4 seconds, and everything within 3 m of where you stood is slowed by 40% for 3 seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

swb_en_garde.name: En Garde
swb_en_garde.desc: Centre stage: a {dmg} ward, +50% armour and +15% damage for 8 seconds, everything within 8 m comes for you slowed, and 40 energy. Does not use the global cooldown. The Panache capstone.

swb_feint.name: Feint
swb_feint.desc: A feint and a cut for {mult} weapon damage that leaves the target's guard open: armour down 12% for {secs} seconds. Flair.

swb_cape_flick.name: Cape Flick
swb_cape_flick.desc: A cape across the eyes and a cut for {mult} weapon damage: the target hits 15% softer for {secs} seconds. Flair.

swb_bravado.name: Bravado
swb_bravado.desc: Every blow you land mends you a little. Life on hit.

swb_thrown_dagger.name: Thrown Dagger
swb_thrown_dagger.desc: A dagger from the boot, thrown 12 m for {mult} weapon damage; the target limps at 70% speed for 3 seconds. Flair.

swb_longer_show.name: Longer Show
swb_longer_show.desc: Flourish's flair lasts longer: more seconds per rank.

swb_encore.name: Encore
swb_encore.desc: They want to see it again: {mult} weapon damage, and the crowd gives you 15 energy back. Flair.

swb_standing_ovation.name: Standing Ovation
swb_standing_ovation.desc: Grandeur lands harder: more damage per rank.

swb_grandeur.name: Grandeur
swb_grandeur.desc: Spend the show: {mult} weapon damage to the target, a full swing to everything within 5 m of it, and a 1 s stagger on all of them. Every flair you are carrying adds to it, so vary your skills first. The Grandeur capstone.

wishlist.rule: `flair: { perSkill: 0.15, max: 5, window: 8 }` on a weapon effect: +perSkill x the number of DISTINCT skills the caster used in the last `window` seconds (capped). Today every Swashbuckler skill writes its own +4% damage buff for 8 s (fx id = skill id + ":damage", so they stack and a repeat only refreshes), which is the same counter at a flat 4% a skill; Grandeur reads it through fxPct like every other weapon hit.
`wall: { secs: 4 }` on a line area: a temporary blocker along the line (walkers path round it). Written today as a 2 s root on everything standing in the line, which holds the pack as a wall would.
